args.title: Fix handling of empty last line in parseStatement
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Change the parseStatement function to correctly handle the last line if it is empty but expected by the data format, preventing the 'Malformed row' error caused by removing an expected empty last line.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parseStatement function in parser.ts currently removes the last line if it is empty, which causes a 'Malformed row' error when an empty last line is expected by the data format. This update fixes that handling to avoid assertion errors on expected blank lines at the end.
